title: Among Us Role Reveal
blurb: The Among Us role reveal — the ominous shimmer that told you whether you were crewmate or impostor, played over the single most consequential second of the match. During 2020 it sounded in roughly ten million bedrooms a night, which is how a small indie game's UI sting became a permanent cultural reference. Now it works for any secret identity surfacing: the friend who was leaking the group chat all along, the colleague who booked the meeting. Everything before this sound is speculation; everything after is strategy.
origin: From Among Us's game-start role assignment screen (InnerSloth, 2018).
